habits.boundary_condition: Do not infer that nonstop service, Wi-Fi, or the absolute shortest duration is always optional; treat such requirements according to the current trip.
habits.condition: When comparing flight options that satisfy any explicitly stated essential needs
habits.default_action: Choose the cheapest suitable option, using duration or convenience only as secondary criteria.
habits.exception_condition: Select a more expensive option only when the user explicitly makes another feature essential for the current search.
habits.name: Prioritize the lowest fare over itinerary quality
habits.rationale: Across three independent flight searches, the user repeatedly returns to the cheapest option even when discussing nonstop service, duration, or other amenities.

source_evidence.contribution: Makes lowest price the controlling criterion while considering a nonstop option.
